prompt: If Anastasia Romanov had still been alive when the 90s cartoon movie based on her was released, how old would she be?
answer: Anastasia Romanov was born on June 18, 1901. When the animated *Anastasia* was released on November 21, 1997, she would have been **96 years old**.
